summary: Poisoned locks still recover in 3 production sites at f422bbbc (and HEAD): dashboard.rs:498 (the approvals lock) and inventory.rs FEATURE_MEMO (HEAD lines 634, 648) call lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner). The brief's Invariants say the dashboard approval lock propagates the poisoned state, and rust-coding-rules.md §5 lists these sites among the 7 to convert. Only artifact_store.rs and git_tier.rs were converted to lock().expect(...); step 1's clippy --fix only rewrote the closures into PoisonError::into_inner. Fix: lock().expect("<lock> lock poisoned") at the three sites. Blast radius: output differs only after an earlier panic; no test covers it.
